title: ID0394654-DC/Si-D/EE-[SqgCtw] - Outlet 1 not able to start charging
description:
Customer went on site. All else worked but he could not get power from the DC 1 so the left outlet.
It went to cable check but failed in cable check and no power was delivered. These are the sessions.
Right outlet does not have same issue
Issue is most likely KF12, can we send a spare part to the customer and replace the KF12

additional_info.subject: ID0394654-DC/Si-D/EE-[SqgCtw] - Outlet 1 not able to start charging CRM:00315002179
additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Veho Võru
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
SqgCtw
Problem Description
: Cannot pass CableCheck in Outlet 1
Troubleshooting
:
Here is a screenshot on why I think it's the KF12:
This is from R&D where they mention that either the dip switches of the KF are not correct or it's faulty.
Here is yours:
Since in this version it's used the IMD for the feedback status, I don't see any strange voltage in the DebugStation:
Sometimes it's a bad indication if we see ~15V in the TF measurement due to the IMD pulses but it doesn't seem to be the case here.
I suggest sending a KF12 to site and replace it.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0394654
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
